answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, an AI economy employs a graph-based web of trust structured as an identity vine, where each agent must stake verifiable computational resources. If a malicious entity attempts to mirror a single agent's state across cloned identities, duplicate nullifiers trigger instant slashing, forcing attackers to incur linear capital costs for every fake node added.
